Ski pass

Your Sinaia ski pass, bought from the train

The ticket queue at the base of the gondola is the first place a ski morning gets lost. Buy your pass online from the gondola's official shop. Create an account (2 minutes), choose a pass, pay by card and walk straight in at the gondola. If you're not sure which pass suits you, message us on WhatsApp the day before.

The gondola's official shopMessage us on WhatsApp
2 minto create an account and buy your pass online; at the gondola, scan the QR code and collect the cardThe gondola's official shop

How you enter the gondola with a pass bought online

You receive a QR code by email. At the gondola entrance there are two machines: scan the code and the machine gives you the physical card. No ticket office queue.

Which pass for which day

For a beginner's first lesson we recommend the half-day pass: a two-hour lesson plus a little more on the beginner slope is plenty for a first day. For a full day of skiing, pass types and this season's prices are on the gondola's shop. If you're unsure, message us on WhatsApp the day before.

Pass prices

The official prices for the current season are on the gondola's shop; they're set by the gondola operator, not by us, and change every season. We don't list them here so as not to mislead you.

Frequently asked questions

Can I buy the pass at the gondola?
Yes, at the ticket office, but that's the queue we'd like you to avoid.
Do I need an account to buy online?
Yes, you create one in 2 minutes on the shop, with your email.
Is the pass on my phone or a physical card?
A physical card: scan the QR code from your email at one of the two machines at the gondola entrance and you receive the card.
Which pass for a first lesson?
Half day. For a first day on skis that's enough.

Not sure which pass to get?

Message us on WhatsApp the day before: we tell you what to get for your level and the time you have.
